HEAVY-DUTY HIGH-CARBON STEEL FRAME

Built with a reinforced high-carbon steel frame, this mountain bike delivers outstanding strength, durability, and stability. Designed to handle rough terrain, long-distance rides, and daily commuting with confidence.

18-SPEED GEARS FOR PRECISE CONTROL

Enjoy smooth and reliable 18-speed shifting that allows quick adaptation to any riding condition. Easily switch gears for climbing hills, cruising flat roads, or accelerating on open trails for a more efficient ride.

FRONT & REAR DOUBLE DISC BRAKES

Equipped with powerful mechanical disc brakes on both front and rear wheels, ensuring responsive and consistent stopping performance. Ride safely with enhanced control even in wet weather, steep descents, or emergency situations.

FRONT SUSPENSION FOR ENHANCED COMFORT

The advanced suspension fork effectively absorbs shocks and vibrations from uneven roads, gravel paths, and off-road trails. Experience a smoother and more comfortable ride across varied terrains.

VERSATILE DESIGN FOR ALL-TERRAIN RIDING

A unisex mountain bike designed for both men and women, ideal for city commuting, forest trails, and mountain adventures.

26" wheel size: recommended for riders 160–183 cm
27.5" wheel size: recommended for riders 172–195 cm

H100 is a mountain bike specifically designed for cross-country riding. Its simple appearance makes it a classic model and is available in multiple colors and sizes. The professional configuration improves its durability and performance on rough terrain to satisfy the rider's riding needs. Also, it's perfect for daily commute, bringing you a variety of cycling options. All in all, H100 can offer an excellent riding experience in the mountains, forests and highways.
